rows.briefing: This trail is about 4.6 km one way with a total climb of 390 meters. The longest sustained climb is 680 meters long, gaining 150 meters. The route features several waterfalls and a summit at 596 meters. Be prepared for steady climbs throughout the walk.

rows.briefing: This trail is about 1.9 km one way with a total of about 80 meters of climbing. The steepest sustained climb is 560 meters long, gaining about 80 meters. The highest point is at 692 meters. The route involves a significant climb followed by a descent.

cues.title: Start

cues.title: High point
